scope: ui_theme on the full rollout. Evidence docs/shots/v4/ (118 shots + 5 contact sheets), contrast figures in docs/progress/UI.md (v4 milestone 2), my own tests in build/web_ui (14:14) with showcase_v3_late: default place, drag over goals, drag into the rail, drag low over the build bar, Find, close all.

ui_theme.key_question: Yes for the HUD and windows: frosted glass that shows the scene through it, brushed-metal bands with domed rivets, engraved seams, chamfered corners, a lit title plate with the family accent line (art/critic/r21_insp_crop.png, r21_hazard_crop.png). Full-screen panels (dashboard, colonists, research) read as dark metal-framed panels rather than glass, which serves readability; they are consistent but less 'glass'.

round_15_fixes_checked.1 glass reads as glass + contrast: landed: the scene shows through HUD glass by day and night; body text 8.9-10.8:1 measured, secondary 5.0-6.1:1 (UI.md).
round_15_fixes_checked.2 nav rail kept clear: landed: a window dragged into the rail moves left of it (my c_into_rail).
round_15_fixes_checked.3 goals/hazard panels: landed: they fold while a window covers them and come back (my b_over_goals, e_find).
round_15_fixes_checked.4 rivets 8-9 px domed, 180 px: landed: domed, readable at 1:1, calm rhythm.
round_15_fixes_checked.7 12 px margin, wrap: landed: long lines wrap in the inspector.
round_15_fixes_checked.8 seams in the glass: landed: hairlines under title plates and between tabs and content.

rollout_rules_checked.one frame language: yes: no cyan brackets left on any screen in the sheets.
rollout_rules_checked.metal-rim buttons: yes: rimmed glass buttons, primary glows inside the rim (menu Resume, title Continue).
rollout_rules_checked.tabs: yes: metal-edged tabs, lit selected tab with the accent line.
rollout_rules_checked.list wells: yes: colonists, inventory and trade tables are seam lists in a darker well.
rollout_rules_checked.charts: yes: dashboard charts on dark wells with seam grid lines.

fixes.fix: At interface scale 125% the build bar overlaps the minimap panel: its left end covers the minimap's lower-right icons (art/critic/r21_s125_crop.png). Lay out the bottom row so the build bar starts right of the minimap at every scale (or shrink the build bar labels to icons at >= 115%).

A window dragged low stays partly off-screen and over the build bar until something else triggers the bounds keeper (my d_over_buildbar: y 700, height 528, still at y 700 two seconds later; moved to 364 only after Find opened). Clamp on drag end: the whole window inside the work area (above the build bar, below the top bar).

Full screens: let a little glass show - a 12-16 px frosted border zone inside the frame where the blurred scene shows, and the body at about 88% instead of opaque - so full screens read as the same glass family as the HUD while tables stay readable.
1280x720 and 80%: inspector tab labels and TEXT_3 hints are small (11 px); at 80% keep text >= 12 px (scale the frame, not the text, below 90%).

notes: PASS 0.77 (up from 0.69). Paul's brief is met on the HUD and windows; full screens are consistent but more metal than glass.
